name: Shadow Island
source:
When a sudden storm wrecks your ship, the only survivors are you, your friend and an indian woman. The three of you are washed ashore on an uncharted island, but only two of you are rescued, taken in by an undocumented British colony.

Now your friend is missing... They're telling you she is dead, that no one could survive outside the village, but you know better. You'll find her, whatever it takes.

Soon, it becomes clear that the island holds many dark secrets which could threaten your life and sanity. Just where did these people come from? Why does no one go into the woods at night? What are these strange looks everyone gives you? And what has happened to your friend? Your quest is complicated by the island's many, beautiful women who all seem to have a special interest in you... and secret agendas of their own...

Will you uncover the island's secrets before they consume you? Or will you give in to temptation and depravity?​
translation:
一场突如其来的风暴，摧毁了你的船。幸存者只有你、朋友，以及一名印度女人。三人被冲到一座海图上未标注的岛屿，但只有两人获救，被一处没有记录在案的英国殖民地收留。

如今，你的朋友失踪了……他们说她已经死了，说没有人能在村外活下来，可你知道，事情并非如此。无论付出什么代价，你都会找到她。

很快，你便发现，这座岛屿隐藏着许多黑暗秘密，足以威胁你的性命与理智。这些人究竟来自哪里？为什么，谁都不肯在夜里走进森林？众人投向你的奇怪目光，又是什么意思？你的朋友，到底遭遇了什么？岛上还有许多美丽的女人，让你的追寻变得更加复杂。她们似乎都对你格外感兴趣，也各自怀有秘密的盘算……

你能否在被秘密吞噬之前，揭开这座岛屿的真相？还是会屈服于诱惑与堕落？
